name: science-skill
description: Skills that counter known failure modes of AI-assisted research: paper-polish (calibrated, exemplar-driven abstract/intro rewriting), number-audit (trace and recompute every number, statistical consistency, guards), experiment-integrity (code and design do what the paper says), proof-audit (obligation ledgers and independent step checks), cite-verify (bibliography metadata and claim support), novelty-audit (falsification-oriented prior-work search), venue-fit (venue choice from verified facts), mock-review (isolated, pinned, verified mock refereeing), dead-end-ledger (honest research ledger with dependencies and stop rules), group-meeting-deck (group-meeting slides in seven styles; numbers, ledger statuses and timing checked), research-poster (posters in six styles at the venue board size; claims and print legibility checked).
